onboarding.desc1: Choose your preferred language and theme to get started with a setup that feels just right for you.
onboarding.title2: Ask clinical questions in plain language
onboarding.desc2: Every question is screened before it reaches the model, and every answer is checked before it reaches you
onboarding.desc3: Names, medical IDs and contact details are detected and masked before retrieval — and again before any answer is shown
onboarding.desc4: Eight checkpoints stand between a question and an answer. Security teams see all of them live; you just see the result
